name: io.github.fmind/portfolio
title: Fmind Freelance AI Architect Website
description: Read-only access to Fmind's portfolio, articles, news, and sites.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Return the core profile: identity, headline, job title, contact, socials, biography, leadership, and areas of expertise.

tools.name: list_experience
tools.description: List professional work experience: companies, roles, descriptions, and skill tags.

tools.name: list_certifications
tools.description: List professional certifications, badges, and course specializations with their issuers.

tools.name: list_publications
tools.description: List academic and written publications: the PhD thesis, peer-reviewed papers, and hosted articles.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search the hosted articles by relevance (BM25 over titles, tags, descriptions, and full text) and return the best matches. Use it to answer what Fmind has written about a topic instead of listing every publication.

query.description: words to search for across article titles, tags, descriptions, and full text (at most 128 characters)
query.title: Query

limit.description: maximum number of results to return (default 10, maximum 50)
limit.title: Limit

tag.description: optionally keep only articles with this tag, case-insensitive: Agent, Coding, LLM, RAG, MLOps, Cloud, Python, Project, Demo, Guide
tag.title: Tag

offset.description: number of matching results to skip for pagination (default 0)
offset.title: Offset

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List open-source projects and educational YouTube series.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: List the professional services on offer (AI architecture advisory and mentoring) with availability and how to book.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Read a public article's complete Markdown, dates, canonical URL, and hosted section links. Use a slug from search_articles; unknown and draft articles are unavailable.

slug.description: public article slug from search_articles or list_publications
slug.title: Slug

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Search or list the daily curated tech news editions (titles, domains, URLs, descriptions, and dates). Omit query to list the latest editions, or pass a query to return matching editions and links.

query.description: optional words or YYYY-MM-DD date to search for across news titles, domains, descriptions, and edition dates (at most 128 characters); omit for the latest editions
query.title: Query

limit.description: maximum number of editions to return (default 10, maximum 50)
limit.title: Limit

offset.description: number of editions to skip for pagination (default 0)
offset.title: Offset

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Read a published daily news edition's complete Markdown, curated links, dates, and canonical URL. Use an edition slug (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD-topic) from search_news.

slug.description: published news edition slug (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD-topic) from search_news
slug.title: Slug

tools.name: compare_llm_hosting
tools.description: Compare a GKE infrastructure budget with managed APIs. Call with parameters={} for defaults and supported models, hardware, and plans. Simple mode accepts preset, model, billing, requests (calls/day), and window (auto, 24, 8, or 1 hour/day); set mode=simple when overriding requests. It sizes replicas under illustrative throughput assumptions. Interactive presets run 24/7; batch presets (document-pipeline) schedule running hours inside active windows. Omit billing (or send auto) for the workload default: batch presets take the cheaper of Flex-start and on-demand and compare against batch API rates. Commitments bill idle hours. Advanced mode keeps the fleet fixed and exposes custom token budgets, throughput, and running time. Break-even holds that fleet fixed and checks its capacity. Totals include compute and GKE; operations and additional services are excluded. Returns assumptions, USD costs, GPU/TPU accelerator comparisons, constraints, sources, and a shareable URL. Invalid inputs fail; no resources are provisioned. See /agents#calculator.

parameters.description: Calculator URL parameters as strings; use an empty object for defaults and available choices.
parameters.title: Parameters

tools.name: compare_mcp_context_cost
tools.description: Count the tool-definition tokens that measured MCP servers (GitHub default toolset, Filesystem, Memory, Playwright) add to every model request, then price them as standard input for the managed APIs in the hosting snapshot. Omit servers for all four. Returns tokens per request and month, context share and USD per 1,000 requests and per 30-day month for each model, dated sources, limitations and a shareable page URL. Reference tokens, not provider billing. See /agents#mcp-context.

servers.description: Distinct server ids; omit for all.
servers.title: Servers

requests_per_day.description: Model requests per day; count every call in agent loops.
requests_per_day.title: Requests Per Day
